walkthrough: Total distance is $200 \text{ km}$ and total allowed time is $2.0 \text{ h}$. The first part is $s_1 = 90 \text{ km}$ at $v_1 = 80 \text{ km h}^{-1}$.
Use $t = s/v$ for the first part: $t_1 = 90/80 = 1.125 \text{ h}$.
Find what is left. Remaining distance $s_2 = 200 - 90 = 110 \text{ km}$. Remaining time $t_2 = 2.0 - 1.125 = 0.875 \text{ h}$.
Required average speed for the rest is $v_2 = s_2/t_2 = 110/0.875$.
Calculate: $v_2 \approx 125.7 \text{ km h}^{-1}$, which to the given options is about $126 \text{ km h}^{-1}$. This is option D.
